about: Pizza slice avatar requested 2026-10-15: the pointy tip should flop around when the streamer moves (the app's bend rig adds a floppy tip zone above the face). Same rules as demo-avatars-01/02: faceless (the app adds the face), no Tripo rig, no brands or text.
style: Fun, charming cartoon style like a polished stylized 3D game asset: smooth chunky shapes, bold readable silhouette, appealing saturated colours.

props.subject: a single thick triangular pizza slice standing upright on its crust like a little character: the puffy golden crust is the flat base at the bottom, the pointy tip points straight up, the slice is thick and soft with a smooth broad area of melted cheese in the middle of the front (room for a face), a few round pepperoni slices near the edges and tip, a little cheese drip on one side, the back is plain baked dough
